svg.title: 16 transmission spectra
svg.desc: All six saved native NoSpin mean propagating-channel spectra, each with221 energy points from−0.5to+0.5eV. Energies are measured relative to each phase own saved Fermi energy, with fixed chemical potential zero for thermal integration. The native transverse average is retained; no spin factor is added to these plotted channel counts, and no smoothing or resampling is applied. Lines simply join adjacent native data points. An independent strict pointwise comparison confirms q2 transmission is lower than parent along b at every one of the221 sampled energies. This is ideal coherent transmission of three-dimensionally periodic bulk structures, not scattering-limited bulk conductivity.

g.text: Along b, q₂ is lower at all 221 sampled energies.
